Strawberries and Sprinkles Cake
By: Ashley E
Published: Monday, January 17, 2011 - 12:25pm

Ingredients




Sprinkles cake mix
2 bags .. freeze dried strawberries
..Marble Mix-Ins sprinkles
..stuff the cake mix calls for

Preparation

1 Make cake mix 2 And then add the strawberries and sprinkles. 3 Pour into cake pans and bake according to the box. 4 Make butter cream icing or your favorite to spread on top 5 Cover with sprinkles
